businessObjectives: Democratize AI agent orchestration through visual programming
Enable anyone to create AI agent teams as easily as Scratch programming
Achieve 10,000 active users creating AI agent workflows by October 22, 2025
Capture 5% of visual programming/automation tool market within 18 months

metadata.name: Dual Canvas System
metadata.description: Implement a dual canvas system with Design Mode for workflow building and Execution Mode for workflow runtime monitoring. Design Mode includes left panel (Explorer), center panel (React Flow Canvas), and right panel (Editor Panel overlay). Execution Mode includes left panel (Nodes), center panel (Canvas), and right panel (Interaction). Editor Panel overlay provides z-index metadata editing for selected nodes.
metadata.userBenefit: Intuitive visual interface for both designing and monitoring AI agent workflows

metadata.name: Universal Node System
metadata.description: Implement a Notion-inspired universal node system where everything is a node. Include 7 core system-defined nodes (agent, task, workflow, artifact_template, checklist, data, artifact_class) and runtime-generated nodes (page, component, data_model, custom types). Support hierarchical parent-child relationships and template-driven customization with auto-generated Artifact Class nodes.
metadata.userBenefit: Unified data model providing consistency, extensibility, and simplicity across all workflow components

metadata.name: Natural Language Agent Definition
metadata.description: Enable users to describe agents with persona definitions and role definitions, tasks with markdown instructions and variable parameters, and workflows in plain English/Korean through text input fields. Automatically translate natural language descriptions into executable AI agent configurations without requiring coding knowledge.
metadata.userBenefit: Create AI agents without any programming knowledge using natural language

metadata.name: Progressive Node Generation
metadata.description: Implement real-time node creation with immediate visual feedback during workflow execution. Nodes should appear on canvas as they're generated according to template definitions, with progressive relationship visualization and immediate interaction capabilities.
metadata.userBenefit: Real-time visual feedback showing workflow progress and immediate ability to interact with generated content

metadata.name: Basic Workflow Execution
metadata.description: Enable execution of simple workflows with 2-3 agents, providing real-time status updates and progress visualization. Support task execution with input/output edges, artifact generation and handoff between agents, with human review and editing capabilities between workflow steps through Editor Panel overlay system.
metadata.userBenefit: Execute AI agent workflows and monitor progress in real-time with ability to intervene when needed

metadata.name: User Authentication
metadata.description: Implement basic signup/login functionality using Clerk authentication. Provide user-specific workflow and artifact storage with session management for workflow instances.
metadata.userBenefit: Secure access to personalized features and workflow storage

metadata.name: Artifact Template System
metadata.description: Create reusable artifact templates for common workflow patterns with support for flow, markdown, table, and custom formats. Enable users to define custom node types through template Node Definition and Edge Definition sub-nodes. Auto-generate Artifact Class nodes from templates for design mode connections.
metadata.userBenefit: Reuse successful artifact templates and create custom node types with visual designers for specific use cases

metadata.name: Artifact Management
metadata.description: Implement artifact management system for generated content (markdown, React Flow, etc.). Provide human review and editing capabilities between workflow steps with version control and export functionality.
metadata.userBenefit: Review, edit, and manage generated artifacts with full control over workflow outputs

metadata.name: Drag-and-Drop Interface
metadata.description: Implement intuitive drag-and-drop functionality for placing nodes on the canvas and creating visual connections between workflow components. Support visual node-relationship connections with immediate feedback.
metadata.userBenefit: Intuitive visual workflow design without requiring technical knowledge

metadata.name: Multi-Language Support
metadata.description: Support natural language agent definition in both English and Korean languages. Provide localized interface elements and documentation for Korean users.
metadata.userBenefit: Create AI agents using native language without language barriers

metadata.name: Real-Time Collaboration
metadata.description: Enable multiple users to collaborate on workflow design and execution in real-time. Provide conflict resolution and user presence indicators for collaborative workflow development.
metadata.userBenefit: Collaborate with team members on AI workflow design and execution

metadata.name: Workflow Export/Import
metadata.description: Enable users to export workflows as JSON files and import existing workflows. Support workflow sharing and template distribution through file-based exchange.
metadata.userBenefit: Share workflows with others and backup/restore workflow configurations

metadata.name: Performance Optimization
metadata.description: Optimize canvas performance to handle 10+ nodes smoothly and ensure workflow execution starts within 5 seconds. Implement efficient rendering and state management for complex workflows.
metadata.userBenefit: Smooth performance even with complex workflows and large numbers of nodes

metadata.name: Error Handling and Validation
metadata.description: Implement comprehensive error handling for natural language processing, workflow execution, and node generation. Provide clear error messages and validation feedback to users.
metadata.userBenefit: Clear feedback when errors occur and guidance on how to resolve issues

metadata.name: Mobile Responsive Design
metadata.description: Ensure the platform works well on mobile devices with responsive design. Optimize touch interactions and canvas navigation for mobile users.
metadata.userBenefit: Access and use the platform from mobile devices with optimized experience

metadata.name: Editor Panel Overlay System
metadata.description: Implement z-index overlay editor panels that appear when clicking nodes on canvas. Provide context-aware metadata editing forms, connected nodes visualization in alternative 2D rendering, and real-time updates. Support different rendering logic for each node type with specialized editors for Node Definition, Edge Definition, and Column Definition sub-nodes.
metadata.userBenefit: Intuitive node metadata editing with specialized interfaces for different node types and immediate visual feedback

metadata.name: Task Input/Output Edge System
metadata.description: Implement input and output edge types for task nodes enabling connections to Data, Checklist, Artifact Class, and Artifact Template nodes. Support task execution flow with clear data dependencies and artifact generation chains. Distinguish between Artifact Class (design mode) and Artifact Instance (execution mode) connections.
metadata.userBenefit: Clear task data flow with input dependencies and output artifacts enabling complex workflow orchestration
